dedupe_keys.name: 100 renewable heat supply in berlin by 2050 a model based approach

description: Philipp Herpich and Konstantin Löffler publish a dataset accompanying their model-based study of fully renewable heat supply in Berlin by 2050. Although Zenodo labels the resource as a journal article, its description explicitly calls it a dataset and its file inventory contains two XLSX spreadsheets alongside a supplementary PDF. The spreadsheet names distinguish MED_RES and LOW_RES variants, whose exact meanings are not explained in the metadata. They are retained together as one study dataset for heat-supply planning. Access is free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is Berlin with a study horizon of 2050; the source does not state the numerical variables, spatial zones, sampling steps or original input vintages. The related GENeSYS-MOD entry describes the model family. Spreadsheet and document contents were not downloaded, so model assumptions and achieved renewable shares remain unverified.
